headline: The opening of the Strait of Hormuz has stirred up the markets
summary: Diplomatic progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz to shipping lifted markets. Brent closed down 6% at $78.70, gold tested $4,130 and the S&P 500 rose 1.79%.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruption there drives crude prices and broader market sentiment.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The S&P 500 rose 1.79% on the improved geopolitical outlook.
